title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Have you gotten any word on the test results?
No. My mom said that the first time she went in they didn’t put her under anesthesia so they are having her come back. So she gets to go through that all again
Well it’s a biopsy of the uterus and apparently it’s quite painful
Oh...I thought they already did the biopsy though

No, I apparently didn’t get the full story from her (think she’s trying to keep it from me until she knows everything). Anyway, she went in, they tried it without anesthesia, it was too painful to do without it. So now she has to go back so they can complete the biopsy
